report: your search is useless, i searched for iphone and got nothing at all

plan.understanding: The user typed 'iphone' into the shop's header search box, submitted it, and the results page showed no products, even though the shop sells iPhones.
plan.expected: Searching for 'iphone' with All Categories selected shows a results page listing at least one product whose name contains 'iPhone'.
plan.objective: Go to https://ecommerce-playground.lambdatest.io. In the header search bar, select 'All Categories' in the category dropdown. Type 'iphone' in the 'Search For Products' box. Click the SEARCH button. Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'. Verify that the search results list at least one product whose name contains 'iPhone'.
